desk.period: Copper South Australia investor site tour, 23–24 Nov 2026 (not a results period)
desk.headline: Not a results release: Copper South Australia site tour sets out plan to grow output to ~500ktpa by 2035 and up to 650ktpa by 2040

other.label: Copper SA unit cost (FY26, after by-product credits)

results: This filing is not a results release: it is the slide pack for an investor and analyst tour of BHP's Copper South Australia assets (Olympic Dam, Carrapateena, Prominent Hill).
BHP plans to lift Copper SA output to about 500ktpa of copper by 2035 (Phase 1) and up to 650ktpa by 2040, roughly doubling it; group copper is meant to reach about 2Mtpa by 2035 from 1.4Mtpa.

Phase 1 rests on block caving and a two-stage smelter: mines and concentrators are put at $5.8–7.5bn and the smelter and refinery expansion at $3.2–4.1bn, with the smelter decision due in the second half of 2027.
BHP says Copper SA can fund Phase 1 from its own cash flow, with peak capital spending of about $3bn (growth plus sustaining); the Prominent Hill expansion starts commissioning in December 2026.
The latest actual results are for the year to 30 June 2026 ; half-year results to December are expected in February 2027.

guidance.summary: No new group earnings or production guidance. The pack gives long-term targets for Copper SA only: ~500ktpa copper by 2035 and up to 650ktpa by 2040, plus project costs and timing, all still subject to study and approval.

items.period: FID H2 CY27, first production FY32

points: Management argued copper demand will outrun supply from existing mines, making new supply scarce and costly.
Block caving and a two-stage smelter were presented as essential to cut mining costs and unlock Olympic Dam's reserves.
BHP said it is applying lessons from cost and schedule problems at its Jansen potash project to the South Australian builds.
By-products are set to rise about 50% by 2035, with gold up 45% and uranium up 65%.
Press coverage said analysts on the tour were positive, and BHP shares rose about 5% after the plan was unveiled.
call.source: Site tour presentation (6-K, 23 Nov 2026) and Forbes, 24 Nov 2026
